summary_en: FY2027 year-end dividend per share increased by 10 yen to 58 yen, raising annual dividend guidance to 106 yen from 96 yen. Upward revision of full-year earnings forecast reflects expanded semiconductor memory demand, higher prices, and yen weakness.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of FY2027 full-year consolidated earnings forecast (upward revision) and revision of year-end dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
MIRAINI Holdings revised its FY2027 year-end dividend per share upward by 10 yen to 58 yen from the previous guidance of 48 yen, raising the full-year dividend guidance to 106 yen from 96 yen. This revision reflects the company's upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings forecast, driven by expanded semiconductor memory demand, higher prices, expanded semiconductor and electronic components transactions, and yen weakness. Sales are now projected at 61.0 billion yen, up 6.2 billion yen from prior guidance.

The company's dividend policy targets a payout ratio of 40% to 50% while balancing growth investments, financial soundness, and shareholder returns. The year-end dividend increase follows this dividend policy principle based on the revised earnings outlook. The company excludes extraordinary profit from the business combination (negative goodwill of 6.395 billion yen recorded in Q1) from dividend resources, treating it as a one-time accounting gain without underlying cash generation.
